story_type: winter Atlantic, injured fisherman basket-hoisted off a fishing boat plowing through heavy seas (helmet cam)
hook: 90 miles out in the winter Atlantic, he had to be lifted off.
narration: Ninety miles out in the winter Atlantic, a fisherman had to be lifted off this boat.
He had badly hurt his arm in a hatch aboard the Sea Rambler, east of Cape Ann, Massachusetts.
An Air Station Cape Cod Jayhawk crew lowered a rescue swimmer toward the deck.
For a hoist, the boat keeps steaming slowly into the wind, so the pilot can hover at the same speed above it.
Then the crew sent the basket down, swinging over the waves.
[short pause] The fisherman was in. The hoist started up.
At the door, the crew pulled the basket inside.
The swimmer came up last, over the same white water.
outcome: The Cape Cod aircrew medevaced the injured fisherman, ninety miles from shore.

location_card.place: 90 miles east of Cape Ann, Massachusetts

title: Hoisted off a boat in winter seas
description:
On Feb. 3, 2022, a Coast Guard Air Station Cape Cod MH-60 Jayhawk crew medevaced an injured fisherman from the fishing vessel Sea Rambler, 90 miles east of Cape Ann, Massachusetts, after he hurt his arm in a hatch.
